description: This file contains utility functions and data structures for handling virtual keyboards in an Android testing environment, including supported keyboards, key mapping, and functions to simulate typing and set keyboards via ADB commands.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the structure of a keyboard, including its name, IME, package, and layout details.

methods.name: getKeyboards
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported keyboards installed on the device by querying the IME list.

methods.name: setKeyboard
methods.description: Sets the device's input method to the specified IME using ADB shell command.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Simulates typing a string on the device using the specified keyboard layout, tapping special keys as needed.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Calculates the x and y coordinates for a given character key on the virtual keyboard layout.

methods.name: getSpecialKey
methods.description: Calculates the x and y coordinates for special keys like Space, Enter, and Period.
